estimates.t: There have been no significant changes in our critical accounting policies and estimates from the information we provided in our most recent Annual Report on Form 10-K.

statements.t: The Company has invested more than $85 million in equipment and engineering for the Rayong, Thailand project to date

P&G products are on shelves, railcars are moving to a large customer, a large global cosmetics company is expected to begin shipping this quarter, and a large global personal care company has approved our white grade.
Including programs in contract negotiation or final qualification, we expect to approach the 40 to 50% utilization range once these programs fully ramp.
“Monthly operations spending was $7.8 million, below our guided range, and we will continue reducing costs into 2027.
The Thailand incentives are in place, the construction permit was issued in September, significant capital has been invested, and we are negotiating the final terms of the project financing.
We’ve reached internal milestones on growth projects, and discretionary spending is on hold while Ironton ramps.”
The Company identified cost reductions, with new measures in effect in Q4 2026 and Q1 2027, and expects to continue reducing costs into 2027.

The Company expects fourth-quarter project spend of approximately $4 million, mainly committed costs of its other projects, and full-year project spend of approximately $51 million, compared with the full-year range of $45 to $50 million provided in August.
Expected project spend in Q4 2026 and 2027 depends on the timing of the Thailand financing, and the Company will provide a 2027 range with its fourth-quarter results.

The date of the Company's fourth-quarter 2026 results call will be announced separately.
In presenting EBITDA and Adjusted EBITDA, the Company aims to provide investors with an additional tool for assessing the operational performance of the Company’s business.
